snippet.title: Skarven Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Link to Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309550/Skarven/

In 2024 my friend Thomas Mygind and I set out to make a game based on our mutual love of Half-Life and the golden age of narrative first person shooters. The result is Skarven, a Steam game set in a dark and distorted vision of our local Danish countryside.

We have a long and exciting journey in front of us so feel encouraged to subscribe to this channel and follow us on Steam to keep up to date. Wishlisting the game on Steam will help us out tremendously.

We’re a small but seasoned team and this is the game we’ve truly been wanting to make all our careers. We’re putting everything on the line so please don’t hesitate to let us know what you think and what you’d be interested in seeing next.

Sound design by Nicolas Vetterli.

With love,
Thomas and Bo.
